name: use-media-query
title: useMediaQuery
description: Whether a CSS media query matches, updated live, and safe to render on the server.
a11y: No DOM output. The first render returns defaultValue so server and client markup match.
Listens to matchMedia changes and removes the listener on unmount.

props.name: query
props.description: A CSS media query, for example `(min-width: 768px)`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Returned for the first render, before the real value is known. Default `false`.
